name: Portainer
description: Browse Portainer environments, stacks and containers from DBX, inspect resource usage and read container logs, with MCP tools for AI clients.
releaseNotes: Adds an MCP tool surface: the plugin now implements the DBX mcp/tools and mcp/call methods and exposes nine read-only tools (environment overview, environments, stacks, containers, container search, database discovery with connection parameters, container inspect, container logs with range/tail/timestamp/search, container stats). Containers can be addressed by name or id. Also ships a reusable, dependency-free MCP support package (backend/mcp) for other plugins. Everything remains read-only.

zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 中浏览 Portainer 的环境、堆栈与容器，查看资源占用并阅读容器日志，同时向 AI 客户端提供 MCP 工具。
